rationale: Figure 1 is a purely metabolic pathway map showing chemical intermediates, enzymatic conversion steps, and cofactors for xylose/glucose assimilation. It contains no nucleic-acid design content — no sequence features, plasmid or circuit composition, or regulatory interactions with a genetic construct — so it falls under the protein/metabolic-pathway exclusion.

Both panels of Figure 2 are growth curves (OD600 versus time) for wild-type and ΔxylB E. coli strains on various carbon sources, containing only quantitative data plots. No panel depicts sequence features, plasmid composition, or genetic circuit design, so there is no nucleic-acid design content that SBOL Visual glyphs could represent.

Figure 3 consists solely of two time-course line plots (A and B) showing OD600 and metabolite concentrations over time for wild-type E. coli and strain Pen205. It contains only quantitative data plots with no depiction of sequence features, plasmid/circuit composition, or construct design; the plasmid pEXT20-khkC-aldoB is named only in the caption, not diagrammed.

Figure 4 consists solely of transcriptomic data displays — a hierarchical clustering heatmap of gene expression across three conditions plus six line plots of log2 expression profiles with KEGG enrichment labels. No panel depicts sequence features, construct architecture, or regulatory interactions of an engineered nucleic-acid design, so there is nothing that could be drawn with SBOL Visual glyphs.

Figure 5 is a single bar chart of molar yields (EG, GA, and total C2) across engineered E. coli strains, with plasmid/genotype names only as axis labels. It contains no diagram of sequence features, plasmid composition, or construct interactions, so there is nothing SBOL Visual glyphs would represent.

Panels (a) and (b) are base-pairing/mechanism cartoons of toehold- and helicase-mediated strand displacement showing bare strand arrows and a protein, with no sequence features, backbone layout, or construct composition being communicated, and panels (c)-(f) are free-energy diagrams and schematic concentration-versus-time plots. Under the checklist's documented exception, mechanism and base-pairing illustrations of this kind were not counted as SBOL Visual compatible.

Under the historical panel's exception, base-pairing/mechanism illustrations with only incidental strand sketches were not counted.
